india_summary: Add the India filter set (Nature, Sunny, Pink, Intense, Tea) next to the normal filters
shutter_summary: Let Pro modes use shutter speeds down to 1/8000 s
zoom_summary: Raise the 6x zoom limit of Video, Pro video and other video modes to 10x
subtitles_summary: Show the real-time subtitles option in Video mode. It uses Xiaomi's online speech service, which may not work on this phone
render_v2_summary: Use the new preview renderer and allow importing Log LUTs in Pro video. Changes the preview in every mode
burst55_summary: Take burst shots at a fixed 55 ms interval, about 18 per second
true_color_summary: Add the Dolby Vision option to Settings > Video. It replaces HLG, and recording may not work on this phone
